sources.title: YH.Model.PAM - GitHub
sources.snippet: YH.Model.PAM This is an open source project folder for YH Intelligence Tech's Probablistic Atmospheric Model (PAM) foundational model, it predicts cloud evolution based on satellite visuals only for 24-72 hours prior and obtains competitive performance against existing multi-factor models.
